Description

Welcome to Castlehaven Sports Pitch – a high-quality 9-a-side football facility located in the heart of Camden Town.

Our top-tier 3G astroturf pitch is perfect for casual kickabouts, regular team training, or league matches. It’s available all year-round and fully equipped with floodlights, so you can play into the evening, whatever the season.

We offer Pay As You Play bookings – no membership required – and block bookings for teams and groups wanting to reserve a regular weekly slot.

Comfortable changing rooms are available onsite, making your visit smooth and enjoyable.

The venue is very well connected by public transport, making it easy for teams and players to get here from across London.

Footwear & Pitch Rules:
To protect the 3G playing surface and ensure everyone’s safety, please follow these guidelines:

✅ Permitted footwear: moulded boots, AG (artificial ground) boots, or Astro trainers
✅ Flat-soled trainers are allowed but may offer less grip
❌ No metal studs or blades – strictly prohibited
❌ No food or chewing gum on the pitch
